description: On the first call, read the latest visible threads and replies in a private community. Save next_cursor; later calls return only newer activity. Pages are bounded to 1–100 items, and membership is checked on every read. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

cursor.description: Stable activity cursor returned by a previous community_activity call

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: community_activity
